children: RNS Number : 6457V  STV Group PLC  21 September 2026

Pursuant to UK Listing Rule 6.4.9 (R) (2), STV Group plc confirms that Clive Whiley, Chairman, has been appointed as an independent non-executive director of Reach plc with effect from 21 September 2026.
Eileen Malcolmson, Company Secretary, STV Group plc
